messages:
zoe (Design): Dropped an alternate stepper for the private setup network page. Key ideas: compact progress bar at top, per-probe "signal strength" bars (3 levels) instead of colored pills, and a small 'Retry probe' link inline. Mock attached. Thoughts?

matt (PM): Nice direction. A few priorities: 1) avoid using only bars/colour for state; include short text and an accessible label; 2) the retry action should be easy to trigger for non-admins but require confirmation if it triggers infra ops.

diego (Eng): Implementation notes: signal bars map to numeric scores (3 = good, 2 = degraded, 1 = blocked). We'll expose an aria-valuenow and aria-valuemin/max on each bar group for screen readers. Example: `<div role=\"progressbar\" aria-valuemin=\"1\" aria-valuemax=\"3\" aria-valuenow=\"2\">` 

rachel (DevEx): UX nit: make the retry a button with a visible focus ring and an aria-live toast on success/failure. If the retry may take >2s show inline spinner and set `aria-busy` on the probe row.

contrast-bot: Automated check: proposed pastel orange fails AA contrast for body text (3.2:1). Recommend darker orange or using the bar fill only for decoration and rely on text+shape for state.

zoe (Design): Good catch. I'll switch to deeper fills and add a label under the bars like "Online / Degraded /Blocked". Also will add a small shape marker on the left to help non-visual users.

matt (PM): Microcopy: change "Retry probe" to "Run check again" and on confirm dialog: "This will re-run network checks for your project; it does not affect live traffic." Keep language reassuring.

diego (Eng): For the confirm flow we can add a lightweight debounce to avoid button mashing. Also we'll log retry events to the preflight audit stream for debugging. For the progress role note: use `aria-live=polite` to announce when a bar moves from 1 to 2 or 3.

rachel (DevEx): Suggestion: keyboard users should be able to expand a probe row to reveal the one-line remediation and the copy-button for the debug command. Pressing Enter on the row header toggles expand/collapse. We'll provide aria-expanded state on the header.

zoe (Design): I'll wire those interactions into the prototype: bar + label + left shape, expandable row with copy button, and confirm modal for retries. I'll annotate focus order and small-screen stacking.

contrast-bot: Quick re-check: updated orange passes AA at hex #b85a00. Confirm visuals with designers.

matt (PM): Also add a small "Why this matters" inline link that opens a contextual panel describing impact on install vs runtime. Keep the panel non-modal.

diego (Eng): One more accessibility detail: ensure the progressbar role isn't used for purely decorative signal; if it's a status indicator prefer `role=\"status\"` with `aria-atomic` and a succinct text node like "SSH: Degraded (2/3)". We'll reconcile in PR.

rachel (DevEx): Draft acceptance checklist:
- signal bars + textual label present
- contrast >= 4.5:1 for labels
- retry is a real button, keyboard accessible, with confirm and `aria-busy` during run
- expandable row uses aria-expanded and Enter toggles it
- copy buttons have aria-labels and announce success via aria-live
- 'Why this matters' opens a non-modal panel and focus lands inside

zoe (Design): Thanks all 44d I'll update mocks and include the proto. Tagging the PR for dev review once ready.

matt (PM): Schedule a quick 10-min sync after mocks land to agree on the progress/role semantics.

diego (Eng): I'll add unit tests for the retry debounce and a11y smoke tests for NVDA/VoiceOver.

rachel (DevEx): Will add the acceptance checklist to the QA ticket and run keyboard/contrast passes.

zoe (Design): Great work. Posting updated frames shortly.
